newsitem.title: USA: Norfolk Southern adds to Illinois lines.
newsitem.headline: Norfolk Southern adds to Illinois lines.

text.p: Norfolk Southern Corp said its trains began rolling Monday on a 49.8-mile segment of track between Urbana and Bloomington, Ill., which Norfolk Southern acquired from Conrail Inc August 31.
The beginning of operations by Norfolk Southern follows a week of track work to upgrade the line and restore a connection to Norfolk Southern's main line at Mansfield, Ill., the railroad said.
After Conrail announced its intention to withdraw from this market, Norfolk Southern acquired the line for undisclosed terms.

The railroad said it responded to requests from Andersons Inc, an Ohio-based grain and fertilizer company with a plant near Champaign, and other local customers to maintain rail service by two major carriers in the Champaign/Urbana area.
"The restored connection at Mansfield will allow Norfolk Southern to provide fast turnaround on grain trains to terminal elevators in Decatur, Ill.
